description.narrative: The purpose of this Activity will be to create a mechanism through which USAID Tashkent can respond to urgent, high priority requests for technical assistance, and use these requests as a window of opportunity to renew relationships with Uzbekistan. Further, activities will lay the groundwork for long term economic and democratic growth and development by providing input and expertise into the legislative reform process, the development of the legal profession, and facilitate strategic planning, including defining roles and paving the way for civil society development. A key feature of the Activity will be intensive work and consultations with GOU and civil society counterparts to identify best practices that have the highest likelihood of long term success in the Uzbek context.
